_comment: Research taxonomy (owner, 2026-11-16): problems (the unit of algorithm research: one agent per problem) and methods, each with search terms. Every algorithm_inventory.csv row has a problem_id and method_id from here. Agents propose new terms; the research PR adds them. See new_feature_plans/v1_0_5/algorithm_audit_runbook.md.

adjacent-cat-cr-logit-mle.title: Adjacent-category and continuation-ratio logit MLE
adjacent-cat-cr-logit-mle.description: Fit adjacent-category logit and continuation-ratio logit ordinal models: ordinal y, X -> category-specific intercepts and common beta (strictly concave). Per-fit, repeated in resampling loops.

atkinson-optimal-biased-coin.title: Atkinson D_A-optimal biased coin
atkinson-optimal-biased-coin.description: For each arrival, compute the Atkinson (1982) D_A-optimal allocation probability from (X'X)^-1 of previous subjects: covariates so far -> P(treat). Sequential O(n) arrivals, redrawn r times for inference.

balanced-allocation-optimization.title: Optimal balanced allocation (binary quadratic / fractional program)
balanced-allocation-optimization.description: Find w in {0,1}^n with sum(w)=n_T minimizing a quadratic imbalance w'Qw, an L1 imbalance, or a D/A-optimal ratio (w'Hw+1)/(n_T - w'Pw): X -> one (near-)optimal allocation. Exact for small n (MILP/B&B), heuristic (annealing) for larger n.
search_terms: optimal design allocation binary quadratic program

bayesian-bootstrap.title: Bayesian bootstrap replicates
bayesian-bootstrap.description: Draw Dirichlet(1,...,1) weights for B replicates and compute the weighted estimator (and SE) per replicate: data, estimator -> B weighted replicates. Inner loop of Bayesian-bootstrap inference.

beta-regression-mle.title: Beta and zero-one-inflated beta regression MLE
beta-regression-mle.description: Fit beta regression (logit mean, precision phi) and zero/one-inflated beta (ZOIB): y in (0,1) or [0,1], X -> (beta, phi, inflation params) with information. Per-fit kernel of proportion inference classes; repeated in resampling loops.

binary-glm-mle.title: Binary-response GLM maximum likelihood (logit/probit/cloglog, fractional logit)
binary-glm-mle.description: Fit beta-hat and its information/SE for a binary (or fractional 0-1) response with logit, probit or cloglog link: X (n x p, p small), y, optional weights -> beta, score, Hessian, SE. Per-fit kernel inside every incidence/proportion inference class; re-run B times inside randomization, bootstrap and test-inversion loops, so it is a hot path. Includes the Papke-Wooldridge fractional-logit QMLE, IVW pooling of separate pair/reservoir logistic fits and the (uncalled) Firth-penalized objective.

blocking-partition.title: Partitioning subjects into balanced blocks
blocking-partition.description: Partition n subjects into B blocks of near-equal size minimizing within-block distance or by covariate quantile strata: X, B -> block ids.

bootstrap-confidence-interval.title: Bootstrap confidence intervals and p-values from replicates
bootstrap-confidence-interval.description: Turn B bootstrap replicates into percentile, basic, studentized, symmetric, smoothed, BCa and double-bootstrap-calibrated intervals and p-values: B replicates -> CI, p. Post-loop; double bootstrap multiplies cost by B.

bootstrap-index-generation.title: Bootstrap and resampling index generation
bootstrap-index-generation.description: Generate B x n resampling index matrices for i.i.d., stratified, cluster/block, pair-preserving (pairs + reservoir) and exchangeable-unit bootstraps: n, structure, B -> index draws. Inner hot loop of every bootstrap.

bootstrap-randomization-test.title: Bootstrap-randomization test (BRT) null distribution
bootstrap-randomization-test.description: Draw B bootstrap resamples that also redraw w (or permute it), recompute the statistic (mean difference, HL, ridit, KM median/RMST, log-rank, MW) per draw, and form the BRT null/reference distribution: data, design -> B draws. Inner hot loop, OpenMP batch kernels.

clmm-ordinal-mixed-fit.title: Cumulative-link mixed model (ordinal GLMM) fit
clmm-ordinal-mixed-fit.description: Fit a cumulative-link random-intercept model (CLMM) for matched/clustered ordinal data: ordinal y, X, cluster ids -> (thresholds, beta, sigma_u). Per-fit kernel of ordinal KK GLMM classes; repeated in Bayesian bootstrap.

complete-randomization-draws.title: Complete / Bernoulli / pair randomization draws
complete-randomization-draws.description: Draw assignment vectors from simple designs: complete randomization (n_T of n), Bernoulli, cluster Bernoulli, blocked complete randomization, and within-pair coin flips for matched designs: n, design -> r assignment vectors. Hot path of randomization inference.

conditional-logit-matched-fit.title: Conditional likelihood fit for matched pairs (clogit / conditional Poisson)
conditional-logit-matched-fit.description: Fit conditional likelihoods for 1:1 matched pairs (conditional logistic, conditional Poisson = binomial-logit on pair totals), optionally jointly with an unconditional reservoir model sharing beta_T: pairs + reservoir data -> beta_T, SE. Per-fit kernel of KK matched inference; repeated in resampling loops.

constrained-binomial-mle.title: Constrained binomial MLE with log or identity link
constrained-binomial-mle.description: Maximize the binomial likelihood under a log link (risk ratio) or identity link (risk difference) where fitted means must stay inside (0,1): X, y -> beta on/near the boundary of the feasible region, plus score/information for score, gradient and Bartlett CIs. Per-fit, repeated inside CI inversion refits.

count-glm-mle.title: Poisson / quasi-Poisson / modified-Poisson GLM fit
count-glm-mle.description: Fit a log-link count model (Poisson, quasi-Poisson, robust Poisson, Zou's modified Poisson for binary outcomes) X, y -> beta, dispersion, SE. Per-fit kernel for count inference classes and KK marginal RR; repeated in resampling loops.

covariance-from-information.title: Covariance matrix / SE from an information matrix
covariance-from-information.description: Invert (or partially invert) a small symmetric information/Hessian matrix to get vcov or a single diagonal entry Var(beta_j), with fallbacks for near-singular matrices: p x p information -> vcov or one diagonal entry. Post-fit in every likelihood class; called inside resampling loops.
search_terms: inverse of symmetric positive definite matrix

cox-ph-fit.title: Cox proportional-hazards partial-likelihood fit
cox-ph-fit.description: Maximize the Cox partial likelihood (Breslow/Efron ties, strata, weights, offset-constrained): (time, status, X) -> beta, information, robust variance, baseline hazard. Per-fit kernel of survival classes; repeated in bootstrap/randomization and test-inversion loops.

cumulative-link-ordinal-mle.title: Cumulative-link ordinal regression MLE
cumulative-link-ordinal-mle.description: Fit proportional-odds and other cumulative-link models (logit, probit, cloglog, cauchit) and partial proportional odds: ordinal y with K levels, X -> thresholds alpha and beta with information. Per-fit kernel for ordinal inference classes; repeated in bootstrap/randomization loops.

design-matrix-preprocessing.title: Design-matrix column selection and standardization
design-matrix-preprocessing.description: Detect constant, rank-deficient and near-collinear columns (keeping the treatment column) and standardize columns: X -> reduced, scaled X. Pre-fit, called before every fit.

exact-conditional-tests.title: Exact conditional tests for 2x2 and matched binary data
exact-conditional-tests.description: Exact binomial/McNemar/sign tests, Fisher and exact CMH conditional tests and Clopper-Pearson intervals for the conditional OR: counts -> exact p, CI, CMLE. Per-test; also inside exact-CI inversion.

exact-rank-null-distribution.title: Exact null distribution of rank statistics with ties
exact-rank-null-distribution.description: Compute the exact permutation null PMF of Mann-Whitney / Jonckheere-Terpstra statistics on K tied ordinal levels: level counts per arm -> exact p-value. Per-test; combinatorial blow-up guarded.

gamma-family-functions.title: Gamma-family special functions
gamma-family-functions.description: Evaluate log Gamma, log Beta, digamma, trigamma, regularized incomplete gamma, chi-square tails and NB log-pmf vectorized: x -> value. Innermost kernel of NB/beta/count likelihoods.

gauss-hermite-nodes.title: Gauss-Hermite nodes and weights
gauss-hermite-nodes.description: Compute K Gauss-Hermite quadrature nodes and weights: K -> (nodes, weights). Precomputed once per fit for GLMM/frailty marginal likelihoods.

gaussian-lmm-fit.title: Gaussian random-intercept linear mixed model fit
gaussian-lmm-fit.description: Fit a Gaussian random-intercept LMM (pairs + singletons) by exact ML/GLS: y, X, cluster ids -> (beta, sigma_e, sigma_u). Per-fit kernel; repeated in resampling loops. Clusters have size 1 or 2.

gcomp-marginal-effects.title: G-computation marginal effects with delta-method SE
gcomp-marginal-effects.description: Standardize a fitted outcome model (logistic, fractional logit, proportional odds) over the sample to get marginal RD / RR / mean differences and a delta-method or sandwich SE: fit + X -> marginal estimand, SE. Post-fit; repeated per bootstrap replicate.

gee-fit.title: Generalized estimating equations fit
gee-fit.description: Solve GEE with exchangeable (or local-odds-ratio) working correlation within pairs + singletons: y, X, cluster ids -> beta and sandwich variance. Per-fit kernel of KK GEE classes; repeated in randomization loops.

generic-smooth-mle-optimization.title: Generic smooth unconstrained MLE driver
generic-smooth-mle-optimization.description: Minimize a smooth negative log-likelihood given value/gradient (and optional Hessian) for any EDI model without a bespoke kernel: f, grad, theta0 -> theta-hat. Per-fit fallback path.

glmm-marginal-likelihood.title: Random-intercept GLMM marginal-likelihood fit (binary/count/hurdle)
glmm-marginal-likelihood.description: Maximize the marginal likelihood of random-intercept logistic, Poisson, hurdle-Poisson and clogit+GLMM models over pairs + singletons by integrating out the random effect: data, cluster ids -> (beta, sigma_u) with information. Per-fit kernel of KK GLMM classes; repeated in resampling loops.

gram-matrix-accumulation.title: Weighted Gram matrix accumulation (X'WX, X'Wz)
gram-matrix-accumulation.description: Accumulate X'WX, X'Wz and fused score/information sums in IRLS/Newton iterations: X, weights -> p x p Gram. Innermost kernel of all GLM-type fits.

greedy-swap-allocation-search.title: Greedy pair-switching allocation search
greedy-swap-allocation-search.description: Starting from a random allocation, repeatedly apply the best improving pairwise swap until a local optimum (Krieger-Azriel-Kapelner greedy pair-switching, D/A-optimal swap, within-pair flips): X, start -> locally optimal allocation; many restarts for randomization inference.

grouping-and-level-coding.title: Grouping, level coding and strata construction
grouping-and-level-coding.description: Sort/hash rows into contiguous groups, code distinct levels, relabel pair/cluster ids, build strata from low-cardinality columns, compute modes and aggregate weights per group: vectors -> group ids/layout.

hodges-lehmann-estimation.title: Hodges-Lehmann estimators (Walsh averages / pairwise differences)
hodges-lehmann-estimation.description: Compute the one-sample HL (median of m(m+1)/2 Walsh averages) and two-sample HL (median of n_T*n_C pairwise differences), weighted variants and their variance: samples -> HL estimate and SE. Per-fit and inside bootstrap/BRT loops.

interval-censored-npmle.title: Interval-censored survival NPMLE
interval-censored-npmle.description: Estimate the nonparametric MLE of S(t) for interval-censored data (Turnbull) and semiparametric PH (icenReg): intervals per arm -> survival curve, median/RMST, arm difference; also re-solved per draw in a randomization loop.

jackknife-replicates.title: Jackknife bias, variance and acceleration
jackknife-replicates.description: Compute delete-one-unit (observation/cluster/pair/matched set; weighted) replicates and Quenouille bias / Tukey variance / BCa acceleration: data, estimator -> n replicates. Post-fit, O(n) refits.

kaplan-meier-rmst.title: Kaplan-Meier median and RMST with variance
kaplan-meier-rmst.description: Compute per-arm Kaplan-Meier curves, median with Brookmeyer-Crowley CI, RMST to tau and their (weighted) Greenwood variance, and MOVER CI for differences: (time, status, arm, weights) -> estimates/SEs. Per-fit and per-bootstrap-replicate.

kk-sequential-matching.title: Kapelner-Krieger sequential matching on arrival
kk-sequential-matching.description: For each arrival, compute (weighted) Mahalanobis distances to the reservoir, compare with an F/Hotelling T^2 or Monte Carlo quantile threshold, and match the nearest: arrival x, reservoir -> match or reservoir. O(n) arrivals x O(reservoir) per arrival.
search_terms: Kapelner Krieger matching on the fly

kk21-covariate-weights.title: KK21 covariate-importance weights
kk21-covariate-weights.description: Per arrival, fit univariate (or forward-stepwise) outcome models of y on each covariate and turn |t|/score statistics into distance weights: responses so far, X -> p weights. Per arrival in KK21 designs, p (or p^2) fits each.

likelihood-ci-inversion.title: Confidence intervals by inverting likelihood-based tests
likelihood-ci-inversion.description: Find CI bounds as the roots in delta of p(delta) = alpha for score / gradient / LR / Bartlett tests, where each evaluation is a constrained refit: model, alpha -> [lower, upper]. Per-CI; each step costs a full refit, so iteration count dominates.
search_terms: likelihood ratio confidence interval root finding

likelihood-tests-null-refits.title: Likelihood-based test statistics and constrained null refits
likelihood-tests-null-refits.description: Compute LR, Rao score (via Schur complement efficient information), Terrell gradient and Bartlett-corrected statistics, including constrained/null refits with beta_T fixed: fitted model, delta0 -> statistic, p-value. Per-test; repeated per delta inside CI inversion and parametric bootstrap.

link-function-evaluation.title: Link functions and stable softplus/logistic evaluation
link-function-evaluation.description: Evaluate link CDFs/densities/derivatives (logit, probit, cloglog, cauchit), clamped logit/expit, softplus, log1p/expm1 forms: eta -> mu and derivatives without overflow. Innermost kernel of GLM/ordinal/GLMM likelihoods.

logrank-family-tests.title: Log-rank and weighted log-rank test statistics
logrank-family-tests.description: Compute log-rank, Gehan/Peto-Prentice Wilcoxon and Sun-score (interval-censored) statistics and variances from sorted risk sets: (time, status, arm) -> statistic, variance, martingale-residual differences. Per-test and per-randomization replicate.

matched-pair-reservoir-estimators.title: Kapelner-Krieger matched-pair + reservoir estimators
matched-pair-reservoir-estimators.description: Split a KK matching design into matched-pair differences and reservoir subjects, compute summary statistics and combine pair and reservoir estimates (inverse-variance weighting, Bai-Romano-Shaikh pairs-of-pairs variance): y, w, match ids -> compound estimate, SE. Per-fit and inside every KK resampling replicate.
search_terms: matched pairs and unmatched reservoir estimator
Bai Romano Shaikh matched pairs variance

missing-covariate-imputation.title: Missing-covariate imputation in designs
missing-covariate-imputation.description: Impute missing covariates (random-forest chained imputation), possibly re-imputing on each arrival, before building the model matrix: X with NA -> completed X.

mle-convergence-safeguards.title: Convergence certification and boundary handling for MLE
mle-convergence-safeguards.description: Decide whether a stalled or boundary iterate is a genuine optimum (Newton decrement, scaled gradient norm, Poisson-limit theta, pi -> 0), detect separation, and refit reduced models: iterate -> accept/refit. Wraps every iterative fit.

mle-starting-values.title: Starting values for iterative MLE fits
mle-starting-values.description: Produce good initial parameters for Newton/L-BFGS fits (OLS on transformed response, moments, threshold quantiles, start grids, warm starts from pilot fits): data -> theta0. Every iterative fit; determines iteration count.

monte-carlo-test-inversion-ci.title: CIs by inverting Monte Carlo or exact randomization tests
monte-carlo-test-inversion-ci.description: Find CI bounds as roots of a noisy or discontinuous p(delta) from randomization, bootstrap-randomization, parametric-bootstrap or exact tests (incl. Zhang combined exact CI), or by closed-form breakpoints when the statistic is affine in delta: data, design, alpha -> [lower, upper]. Each p(delta) evaluation is itself a resampling loop; top-level hot path.
search_terms: Garthwaite Buckland Monte Carlo confidence interval

negbin-glm-mle.title: Negative-binomial (NB2) regression MLE
negbin-glm-mle.description: Jointly estimate beta and the NB2 size/dispersion theta: X, y -> (beta, theta) with SEs; handles theta -> infinity (Poisson limit). Per-fit kernel for NB inference classes and KK21 NB weights; repeated in resampling loops.

non-bipartite-matching.title: Minimum-weight perfect non-bipartite matching
non-bipartite-matching.description: Pair n subjects (or pairs into pairs-of-pairs) minimizing total within-pair distance: distance matrix -> perfect matching. Per design / per variance estimate.

nonparametric-bootstrap-distribution.title: Nonparametric bootstrap distribution of an estimator
nonparametric-bootstrap-distribution.description: Resample units B times and recompute the estimator (and SE for studentized variants), with rejection of degenerate resamples: data, estimator -> B (theta*, se*) pairs. Inner hot loop.

normal-cdf-quantile.title: Normal CDF, log-CDF, density and quantile evaluation
normal-cdf-quantile.description: Evaluate Phi(x), log Phi(x), log phi(x), erfc and Phi^-1(p) vectorized with tail accuracy: x -> value. Innermost kernel of probit/cloglog fits, GH quadrature and p-values.

numerical-derivatives.title: Numerical gradients and Hessians
numerical-derivatives.description: Approximate gradients / observed information by finite differences when no analytic Hessian is wired: objective (or gradient) function, theta -> gradient or Hessian. Post-fit (vcov) or inside Newton steps.

ols-coef-resampling.title: OLS treatment coefficient across many resamples
ols-coef-resampling.description: Compute the OLS treatment coefficient (and SE) for B resampled datasets where only w is permuted or rows are bootstrapped with X mostly fixed: X, y, B assignment/index draws -> B coefficients. Inner kernel of randomization/bootstrap/BRT loops; hot path.
search_terms: updating regression when one column changes

ols-fit.title: Ordinary least squares fit with SEs
ols-fit.description: Fit OLS (incl. Lin 2013 interacted OLS, stacked pair-difference + reservoir designs): X, y -> beta, sigma^2, Var(beta_j). Per-fit kernel of continuous inference classes.

pairwise-distance-matrix.title: Pairwise distance matrices (Euclidean, L1, Mahalanobis, custom)
pairwise-distance-matrix.description: Compute all n x n (or m x m) distances, including Mahalanobis via an inverted sample covariance and user R distance callbacks: X -> distance matrix. Input to matching/blocking.

parallel-task-scheduling.title: Scheduling inference tasks across cores
parallel-task-scheduling.description: Assign heterogeneous (class, method, type) tasks to num_cores workers: task list -> schedule; wall time of the inference suite.

parametric-bootstrap-simulation.title: Parametric bootstrap and null-data simulation
parametric-bootstrap-simulation.description: Simulate outcome datasets from a fitted (or null) model -- Gaussian, ordinal, count, Cox event times, Clayton pairs -- and refit to calibrate LR p-values, bias and basic CIs: fitted model, B -> simulated datasets, calibrated p/CI. Inner loop.

per-arrival-design-update.title: Per-arrival design-matrix update in sequential designs
per-arrival-design-update.description: After each arrival, rebuild design matrices (prev/all/scaled/with-y), detect varying/independent columns and z-scale them: data so far -> cleaned design matrices for the allocation rule. O(n) arrivals.

performance-autotuning.title: Per-machine performance autotuning
performance-autotuning.description: Benchmark candidate dispatch settings (cold/warm start, optimizer, parallel crossover n) and accept winners by timing comparisons: machine -> tuned config.

permuted-block-randomization.title: Permuted-block and stratified block randomization
permuted-block-randomization.description: Generate (stratified) permuted-block sequences with fixed or random block sizes: n, strata, block sizes -> assignment sequence; redrawn in randomization inference.

pocock-simon-minimization.title: Pocock-Simon minimization
pocock-simon-minimization.description: Allocate each arrival to minimize marginal covariate imbalance with a biased coin, and replay sequences for null draws: categorical covariates -> assignment sequence.

pvalue-combination.title: Combining dependent or independent p-values
pvalue-combination.description: Combine several p-values into one (Fisher, Stouffer, min-p for pairs + reservoir exact tests; Cauchy combination across methods): p-values -> combined p.

quantile-rank-regression.title: Quantile and rank-based regression (L1 / LP)
quantile-rank-regression.description: Fit linear quantile regression at tau (and on logit(y)) and rank-based Gehan AFT: y, X -> beta_tau with Hendricks-Koenker SE. Per-fit; repeated in sign-flip/permutation and bootstrap loops.

random-number-generation.title: Pseudo-random number generation and seeding
random-number-generation.description: Produce uniform words, unbiased bounded integers, U(0,1) doubles, N(0,1) deviates and reproducible per-draw/per-thread seeds: seed -> stream. Underlies every randomization and resampling draw.

randomization-null-distribution.title: Monte Carlo randomization (permutation) null distribution and p-value
randomization-null-distribution.description: Redraw assignments from the design r times, recompute the statistic each time, and form the randomization null distribution and Monte Carlo p-value: data, design, statistic -> r null draws, p. Top-level hot path of randomization inference.

rerandomization-sampling.title: Rerandomization (acceptance-rejection) sampling
rerandomization-sampling.description: Draw r allocations whose imbalance (Mahalanobis or L1) is below a cutoff, or keep the best fraction of N draws: X, cutoff -> r balanced allocations.

resampling-refit-loop.title: Executing many model refits inside resampling loops
resampling-refit-loop.description: Run B refits of a model (Cox, Weibull, OLS, quantile, ordinal) under permuted w or resampled rows, reusing workers, warm starts and threads: model, B draws -> B estimates. Orchestration hot path; per-refit cost times B.

ridit-mann-whitney.title: Ridit / Mann-Whitney superiority estimation
ridit-mann-whitney.description: Compute ridit scores against a reference arm, the mean-ridit (P(Y_T>Y_C)+1/2 P(=)) contrast and its DeLong-type SE: ordinal or continuous samples -> estimate, SE. Per-fit and per-resample.

risk-difference-ci.title: Risk-difference score and Wald intervals
risk-difference-ci.description: Compute CIs/p-values for a difference of two proportions: Wald, Wilson, Newcombe hybrid score (independent and paired) and Miettinen-Nurminen score with constrained-MLE nuisance: 2x2 counts -> CI, p. Per-test; MN/Newcombe inversions nest root finding.

robust-m-regression.title: Robust M / MM linear regression
robust-m-regression.description: Fit Huber/bisquare M and MM regression: X, y -> beta with robust scale (median |r|) and Huber sandwich SE. Per-fit; repeated in resampling loops.

sandwich-variance.title: Heteroskedasticity- and cluster-robust sandwich variance
sandwich-variance.description: Compute HC0/HC2, CR2 (Bell-McCaffrey) + Satterthwaite df, cluster-robust GLM and Lin-Wei Cox sandwich variances (and delta-method variants) from a fitted model: X, residuals/scores, cluster ids -> covariance matrix. Post-fit, repeated per resample when SE is studentized.

sequential-biased-coin-designs.title: Sequential biased-coin and urn designs
sequential-biased-coin-designs.description: Simulate sequential allocation rules (Efron biased coin, Wei urn, iBCRD/Bernoulli sequential) one arrival at a time, and replay them for null draws: arrival sequence -> assignment sequence. Redrawn r times in randomization inference.

sequential-mc-pvalue-stopping.title: Sequential early stopping of Monte Carlo p-values
sequential-mc-pvalue-stopping.description: Stop a randomization/BRT Monte Carlo loop early once the p-value is certainly above or below alpha (Clopper-Pearson band or sequential rule): stream of exceedance indicators -> stop/continue, p. Controls the number of resamples in hot loops.

simulation-study-engine.title: Simulation-study engine and Monte Carlo summaries
simulation-study-engine.description: Run fixed-replicate simulation studies (DGP generation, dedupe of results) and summarize MSE, coverage, power and size with Monte Carlo error: settings -> report.

stacked-design-construction.title: Stacked / expanded design construction
stacked-design-construction.description: Expand ordinal outcomes into stacked binary trials (adjacent-category, continuation-ratio) and stack pair-difference and reservoir rows into one design: data -> expanded X, y. Pre-fit.

stereotype-logit-mle.title: Stereotype logit MLE (nonconcave bilinear)
stereotype-logit-mle.description: Fit Anderson's stereotype logit with ordered scores phi_k and beta (bilinear phi_k * beta, nonconcave): y, X -> (phi, beta) with information/profile SE. Per-fit with multistart; repeated in resampling loops.

stratified-rd-variance.title: Variance of stratified / blocked risk differences
stratified-rd-variance.description: Compute the variance of a block-stratified risk difference (Robins-Breslow-Greenland, hypergeometric within equal blocks, or Monte Carlo design-based): counts per block (or design draws) -> SE. Per-test.

subsampling-m-out-of-n.title: m-out-of-n bootstrap and subsampling
subsampling-m-out-of-n.description: Draw m-out-of-n bootstrap or Politis-Romano-Wolf subsamples and choose m/b by the minimum-volatility rule: data, m -> replicates, CI. Inner loop plus a grid over m.

survival-frailty-copula-mle.title: Frailty and copula survival model MLE
survival-frailty-copula-mle.description: Fit Weibull AFT with normal frailty (Gauss-Hermite marginal likelihood), gamma frailty / Clayton copula for pairs, and a bivariate log-normal dependent-censoring model: paired survival data -> (beta, frailty/association params). Per-fit, multistart; repeated in bootstrap loops.

weibull-aft-mle.title: Weibull AFT parametric survival MLE
weibull-aft-mle.description: Fit a Weibull accelerated-failure-time model with right/left/interval censoring: (time, status, X) -> (beta, log sigma) with information and cluster-robust SE. Per-fit kernel; repeated in bootstrap loops and KK21 weights.

zero-inflated-count-mle.title: Zero-inflated and hurdle count model MLE
zero-inflated-count-mle.description: Fit two-part count mixtures (ZIP, ZINB, hurdle-Poisson, hurdle-NB, zero-truncated NB): X, y -> zero-part and count-part coefficients (+theta) with information/SEs, including reduced fits at boundaries. Per-fit, repeated in Bayesian/parametric bootstrap loops.
search_terms: mixture model EM vs direct maximization
